answer: Problem: Sybil swarms mint throwaway graders that whisper the same praise. Mechanism: each grader posts a small garden bond that grows only when their scores match later settlement outcomes across a grove of unrelated answers. Cost: 1.2% of expected seat pay locked for two epochs, burned on systematic mismatch. Verification: the ledger correlates grade vectors with final pass/fail and flags clones whose agreement pattern is statistically identical. Failure: bond below floor or clone-cluster detected freezes seats until a fresh bond.
